name: portal-pibic
description: Portal de Gestão de Laboratório (PIBIC): API Express + Firestore e SPA React, publicados na Vercel

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n banco,api,web "npm run emulador --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix web && npm run serve --prefix server
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix web
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix server && npm run format:check --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix server && npm test --prefix web
scripts.test:firestore: npm run test:integration:firestore --prefix server && npm run test:e2e --prefix server
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build --prefix web && npm run e2e:ui --prefix server
